recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 1980s-style dark hair, dressed in a black satin coat and leggings, set against a neutral, textured grey background. The composition is anchored by a sharp pop of red in the gloves and graphic elements, utilizing a high-contrast, moody lighting scheme.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the deep black satin textures and the flat, cool-grey studio background.
Visual link between the red lace gloves and the red graphic accents in the top-right corner.
Verticality of the subject's pose mirrored by the downward trail of graphic squares.
coreInvariants: Red lace and leather gloves as the primary color pop.
Neutral, slightly vignetted grey studio floor and wall.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, full-body scale, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and red-gloved hand near the mouth serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down the black coat to the boots, then jump to the red graphic text and trailing squares in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left and right sides creates a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool neutral grey (background) and deep black (clothing).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and subtle highlights on satin fabric.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black subject and grey background; high saturation contrast between the red accents and the rest of the muted palette.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, grey, red, and natural skin tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A combination of a loose, hand-drawn script and a condensed, high-contrast serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script text features uneven, textured strokes resembling thick paint or lipstick.
Serif text uses extreme vertical compression with thin horizontal strokes and thick verticals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'J' and 'R' have elongated, expressive tails.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, organic red script paired with rigid, mechanical black serif for a 'heart vs mind' visual metaphor.
graphicDevices: A vertical trail of small red squares falling from the end of the script text.

preserve: Color contrast between red and black text
The condensed nature of the serif font

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, narrow serif style of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio photograph of a woman with 80s big hair, wearing a black satin coat, black leggings, and red lace gloves, standing on a grey studio floor against a grey wall with soft vignette lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a red hand-drawn script title in the top right, with a black ultra-condensed serif subtitle underneath. Include a trail of small red squares falling vertically from the right side of the text.

verificationChecks: Is the hair sufficiently voluminous and textured?
Are the gloves a vibrant red lace?
Is the subtitle font extremely narrow and high-contrast?
Does the red square trail follow a natural downward path?

adjustableVariables: Sheen level of the black satin coat
Length and density of the falling red square trail
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the model

mustAchieve: Clean studio lighting with soft shadows

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red gloves are the primary color focal point on the subject.
Verify the text is positioned in the upper right quadrant.
Confirm the background is a neutral, textured grey.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a full-body 80s fashion portrait in black satin against a grey studio backdrop with a two-tier typographic lockup in the top-right corner featuring red script and black condensed serif.
